ic_name: System Management Bus (SMBus 3.1) + Power Management Bus (PMBus 1.3)

bus_waveform.start: SMBDAT falls while SMBCLK is high.
bus_waveform.stop: SMBDAT rises while SMBCLK is high.
bus_waveform.repeated_start: A new START without an intervening STOP (Read Byte/Word, Process Call, Block Read).
bus_waveform.bit_sampling: Data is valid/sampled while SMBCLK is high; data changes while SMBCLK is low.
bus_waveform.ack: Receiver pulls SMBDAT low on the 9th clock to ACK.

transaction_waveform.generic: START | Addr[6:0]+RW | ACK | (Command | ACK) | (ByteCount | ACK) | Data | ACK ... | (PEC | ACK) | STOP

pec_waveform.definition: CRC-8 (poly 0x07, init 0x00) over every transmitted byte; the PEC byte is the last byte before STOP.
pec_waveform.check: Receiver recomputes the CRC and NACKs on mismatch.

general_timing_rule: SMBus is synchronous to SMBCLK (master-driven). Each byte is 8 bits MSB-first followed by an ACK/NACK clock. Optional PEC adds one byte. Unlike I2C, SMBus mandates a 10 kHz minimum clock and clock-low timeouts so a stalled transaction is detected and the bus recovered.
